Local-first tools keep files on your device; cloud-document tools give you a browser and multi-device experience. MyGitNotes points both ways of working at the same Markdown and Git workspace. There is no second cloud copy to export, import, or reconcile.
features: Notes use ordinary Markdown with optional YAML frontmatter; Git preserves history and records explicit commits.

Browse notes flat (every note under the selected folder, the default), by folder (one level with its subfolders), or on a Kanban board; the notes show as a table where the page has room and as cards where it is narrow…

In the sidebar, drag a folder to reorder it among its siblings or drop it into another folder (with a mouse at once, on touch after a long press), and drop a note from the note list or its cards on a folder or its…

The note toolbar starts with its view: one button switches live preview and source (its icon is the mode in use, in a graph card too; in zoom and in a Focus pane the leader Mod+Shift+E then M does the same, beside F for…

Settings → Editor turns on Vim keys for this browser in live preview and the file source editor, with Vim's status line below the text; a note's source mode stays a plain text box. :w does what the note's Commit does…

requirements.text: Local mode needs no OAuth account.
Pi runs as your local user and can run any command, so the agent accepts only local connections; through pnpm dev:remote it admits only the Tailscale login that owns this machine.
